summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a court ruling by the 7th Panel of the Federal Regional Court of the 1st Region (TRF1) in Brazil regarding five lawsuits challenging Ordinance No. 120/2016, which relates to the inclusion of RBSE assets in transmission concessionaires' tariff base. The panel partially granted appeals, declaring nullity of Paragraph 3 of Article 1 of the ordinance and ordering offset of certain Ke remuneration amounts already paid. AXIA is not a party to the proceedings but disclosed the development. This is a routine legal update, not a special-situation corporate event.
